question: Who among the following rulers was defeated in the battle for Pataliputra by Chandragupta Maurya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhana Nanda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhana Nanda** was the last ruler of the Nanda dynasty in ancient India.
 
• He was defeated by **Chandragupta Maurya** with the assistance of his mentor and strategist **Chanakya** (also known as Kautilya).
 
• This victory marked the beginning of the **Maurya Empire**, which became one of the largest empires in Indian history.
 
• The battle for Pataliputra was a significant event that led to the establishment of Chandragupta Maurya's rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** founded the Maurya Empire in 321 BCE and ruled until 297 BCE.
 
• The Maurya Empire is known for its significant contributions to Indian culture, administration, and economy.
 
• Under Chandragupta's reign, the empire expanded to cover large parts of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• His rule was marked by the establishment of a centralized government and a complex administrative system.
 
• Chandragupta's grandson, **Ashoka the Great**, is one of India's most renowned emperors, known for his promotion of Buddhism and non-violence.
